title: NP-hardness transfers through polynomial-time reductions
statement: Let $L$ and $L'$ be languages over the Boolean alphabet. If every language in $\mathsf{NP}$ is polynomial-time many-one reducible to $L$, and $L$ is polynomial-time many-one reducible to $L'$, then every language in $\mathsf{NP}$ is polynomial-time many-one reducible to $L'$.
